snippet.title: Starship Troopers: Terran Command - The Eradicators | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The Eradicators is the first Battle Group DLC for Starship Troopers: Terran Command, focusing exclusively on new Territory Mode content. 

Originating from the labs and research facilities on planet Ghutana, The Eradicators Battle Group features a new set of unique, R&D-based units and technologies: exterminate the Arachnids with deadly chemical substances, pulverize them with powerful nuclear and radiation weapons or utilize top-secret biological technology to unleash your own controlled Bug hordes.

🎮 Wishlist now on Steam ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3454110/Starship_Troopers_Terran_Command__The_Eradicators/
💬 Join the Discord Server ➡️ https://discord.gg/gAwt99fpmP
